verdict.rationale: Usage visibility and spend alerts are a fair axis for an invoicing and billing product, but the evidence pack never documents usage metering, real-time accrued-cost views for customers or the team, or threshold alerts. The preview-invoice API endpoint is at most a developer building block. Quotes and overdue reminders are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
